caption: The drawing depicts three distinct objects, all related to a saddle. The main object, occupying the upper left portion of the composition, is a detailed depiction of a brown leather saddle adorned with elaborate embossed or tooled designs, including floral and geometric motifs. The saddle features a prominent horn at the front, curved seat, and detailed side panels, with straps and metal rings visible. In the lower right section of the drawing is a semi-circular piece, also brown with similar decorative patterns, possibly part of the saddle or a related accessory, showing a central floral design and intricate borders. On the left side, below the saddle, is a smaller rectangular piece of brown leather, featuring a diamond-shaped embossed pattern with additional decorative tooling inside. The background is plain and off-white, highlighting the rich brown and reddish tones of the leather and the detailed craftsmanship of the embossed patterns.
title: Double Rig Saddle
